measurement: client observed submission through terminal observation; output validation measured separately

output_content.population: Durable output rows with valid choice/message shapes; length_capped means any choice ended with length

workload.hash_definition: concatenated exact JSONL bytes in batch_index order
workload.message_template: exact provided messages; run_id prepended to custom_id

submission.request_population: POST /v1/files and POST /v1/batches only; excludes polling and downloads

limitations: Token lengths are measured from outputs, not guaranteed by the prompt
Batch turnaround starts before POST /v1/batches and ends at first client-observed terminal response; polling adds observation delay
No per-task inference latency or quality evaluation; final text presence is counted separately from durable completion
Reported generated tokens can include reasoning and control tokens; reasoning-only length-capped outputs remain durable completions
Accepted counts require a received create acknowledgement; uncertain create errors may have committed server-side
workload_class_definition: observed prompt/requested output cap >=16 prefill_heavy, <=4 decode_heavy, otherwise balanced
